repos_data.description: MCP server: verifiable oracle services (Platon VRF, Chronos VDF, LUMEN reputation) for AI agents — pay-per-call over the AIMarket protocol, every result independently verifiable.
Nginx webserver and reverse proxy with php support and a built-in Certbot (Let's Encrypt) client. It also contains fail2ban for intrusion prevention.

55 tools. One URL. Free tier — no credit card.  Verified public data — CVE/SBOM security audits, licence compliance, frontend security scanning, nonprofit 990 filings, federal contracts, NPI lookups, patents, and domain intelligence — delivered as AI-Ready Markdown inside any MCP client.
Self-hosted email for AI agents — the open-source alternative to AgentMail. One compose file → unlimited inboxes, OTP extraction, MCP server.
